page.content:
Smiling desert conglomerate that buys Desert Bluffs and tries to buy Night Vale.

How StrexCorp Synernists Inc. connects

  • Location: Desert Bluffs — StrexCorp owns Desert Bluffs as a company town.
  • Character: Tamika Flynn — Tamika Flynn leads the resistance to StrexCorp's occupation.
  • Location: Night Vale — Night Vale resists StrexCorp's attempt to buy the town and the station.
  • Character: Kevin — Kevin speaks StrexCorp's smiling language on Desert Bluffs radio.

What is StrexCorp Synernists Inc.?

StrexCorp is the yellow-logo company that owns Desert Bluffs, speaks in productivity parables, and occupies Night Vale Community Radio until Tamika Flynn and the town push it back.

Key threads lead to Desert Bluffs, Tamika Flynn, Night Vale and Kevin.
